The '''Malthee Temple''' was a [[Doellinism/Legends|Doellinist]] temple built on the ruins of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Malthee]], which was destroyed in an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Massacre at Malthee|bombardment]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
